popover.$description: Popover, and the hover-card / preview-card surfaces built on the same anchored-overlay recipe. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group.

border.$description: A real border, not a box-shadow ring: forced-colors mode strips every shadow, and an overlay with no edge is Canvas on Canvas there.
